Class UdevData

java.lang.Object
oshi.util.linux.UdevData
@ThreadSafe public final class UdevData extends Object
Reads device properties from the udev database that systemd-udevd keeps under /run/udev/data. The files are world-readable and hold the same E: properties libudev returns from udev_device_get_property_value, so code that cannot load libudev can still read them.

Each device has one file, named by subsystem: b<major>:<minor> for a block device, n<ifindex> for a network interface, and +<subsystem>:<name> for a device with no device node, such as a PCI function. A host without udevd, such as most containers, has no database; every query then returns an empty map.

      public static Map<String,String> queryBlockDevice(String dataDir, int major, int minor)
      Reads the udev properties of a block device from a given database directory. Used for testing and for a database copied from another host.
      Parameters:

      minor - the device's minor number

      the properties, or an empty map if there is no record
